text: Replacing capital with reputation gives DAOIC members a permanent option and a right of first refusal on deals, because a member can stake reputation non fungible tokens on a deal without joining the purchase commitment.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098

isBasedOn.name: Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance

abstract: The replacement of capital with reputation gives the DAOIC members a permanent option and right of first refusal on deals. DAOIC members can merely stake RNFT on a deal without participating in the purchase commitment for such a deal.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: DAOIC operating model with RNFT staking separated from capital commitment
